software: ZBrush, Maya, Substance Painter, Marmoset Toolbag
desc:
Big Bad Wolf is our 3D take on Nicola Saviori's concept: a hunched, hooded wolf with glowing red eyes, a drooling grin, a huge bushy tail and a pair of curved blades. The job was to keep everything that makes the 2D design fun while making it work from every angle.

The shapes stay bold, with a big head and hands, a skinny body under the cloak and an oversized tail, so he reads instantly even on a phone screen. All of it fits in 13K tris and a single 2K texture set, with painted-style colors that hold the concept's look under real-time lighting. Topology is clean and deformation-ready, so he can go straight to rigging and animation.

Need stylized enemies or heroes for mobile, Switch or PC? We can match this look, or take it wherever your project needs to go.
